name: Hanover (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Hanover (a white wall with towers and a lion on red).
history: Municipal flag of Hannover; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hanover arms — white wall with towers and lion on red
